claims.source_quote_ar: يَجُوزُ أَنْ يكون مِنْهُم رَافعا لمن
claims.claim_ar: يجوز أن يكون «مِنْهُمْ» رافعًا (مرفوعًا) في تركيب «مِنْهُمْ مَنْ ...» أي في موقع المبتدأ/الفاعل بالنسبة لما بعدها.
claims.claim_en: It is permissible that «minhum» be in a raised position (i.e. acting as subject) in the construction «minhum man ...», i.e. functioning as a subject/raiser with respect to what follows.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source states a permissive alternative for the phrase «مِنْهُمْ مَنْ ...»; it is not fully explicit whether the author intends the raising specifically on «مِنْهُمْ» or on the clause as a whole.

claims.claim_ar: يجوز أن تكون الجملة «مِنْهُمْ مَنْ ...» مبتدأً وخبرًا (أي أن سياقها يكون على صيغة جملة اسمية مبتدأ وخبر).
claims.claim_en: It is permissible that the clause «minhum man ...» be a nominal sentence with a mubtada' and khabar (i.e. function as a subject-predicate construction).
claims.needs_review_reason: The source gives alternative analyses for the clause; mapping this general statement to a single word in the verse (here attached to «مَنْ») is interpretive and should be reviewed.

claims.claim_ar: الجملة («مِنْهُمْ مَنْ ...») تُعرب نعتًا لِـ«رُسُلٍ» في القراءة التي تعتبرها وصفًا للرُّسُل.
claims.claim_en: The clause («minhum man ...») can be parsed as a modifier (na‘t, adjective/clause) qualifying “rusul” (messengers) in the reading that treats it as characterizing the messengers.
claims.needs_review_reason: The source attributes the role of the clause as a modifier to an external noun (messengers) not present in this immediate verse; the exact governor to which the clause attaches in the ayah requires review.

claims.claim_ar: يجوز أن تكون الجملة «مِنْهُمْ مَنْ ...» مستأنفة (مبتدأ لموضوع مستقل مُستأنف عنه)، أي أنها قد تقرأ كمستأنف بذاتها.
claims.claim_en: It is permissible that the clause «minhum man ...» be a resumed clause (musta'naf), i.e. read as an independent resumed sentence.
claims.needs_review_reason: The statement in the source is general; determining whether the 'musta'naf' reading applies in this specific ayah and which token is the syntactic pivot needs confirmation.
